name: Quotidian Quagmire
subtitle: you push! we'll pull!
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. That character's controller may detach up to 2 resources from their faction. -- This turn, the character loses 1 speed. Draw a card.

name: God's Blessing of Foresight
subtitle: the living god divinates
rules: UNIQUE BLESSING -- ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains the following rules text: "At the start of your turn, you may pick a character you control and put a token on it. -- All your characters lose 1 speed. Each character you control with a token on it gains 1 strength and COVERT."

name: Ecto-Conduit
subtitle: harnassing the unknown power of the void
rules: At the start of your turn, you may draw three cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your deck in any order. -- HARNESS -- COST – Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Void the top card of your deck. If it is a tactic, you may deploy it as though it was in your hand even if you cannot meet its threshold.

name: Quotidian Assassination
rules: COST - Pick a character. -- EFFECT - Put the character into its owner's hand.
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: / unlabelled effect; card prints COST - / EFFECT - labels. Same play.

name: Quipster D'Genie
subtitle: phenomenal cosmic power
rules: WISH -- COST – Pay 2. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a tactic and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand.
